reason: Extraction-optimisation table: properties and yield of pectin isolated from dried apple pomace under ultrasound- vs microwave-assisted extraction at different pH, liquid-to-solid ratio and duration, with no untreated reference and no culinary treatment of a food (caption says SD, Methods say standard error of the mean).
foods: apple pomace (Golden Delicious) powder and the pectin extracted from it
treatments: ultrasound-assisted extraction (37 kHz, 60 ± 1 °C, 15 and 30 min) and microwave-assisted extraction (450 W, 5 and 10 min) in aqueous citric acid at pH 1.5, 2.0, 2.5 and liquid-to-solid ratio 10, 15, 20 (v/w)
methods_quote: The extraction of pectin using the microwave-assisted extraction (MAE) method was performed in a microwave oven (MS23F301TAS Samsung, Zhongshan, China) with a magnetron power of 450 W for 5 and 10 min.
basis_quote: expressed in milligrams of gallic acid equivalents per 1 g of dried sample weight (mg GAE/g DW)
units: %; g/mol; mg GAE/g DW; μmol TE/g DW
replicates: triplicate; caption/footnote: mean ± SD; Methods: mean values ± standard error of the mean
